reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a file folder containing both a checkmark and an X mark, making it an unmistakable symbol for triaging, culling, or approving/rejecting files and directories. While more specialized than a plain folder, it fits common digital and physical decluttering tasks (keep vs. delete) and review workflows well, though at tiny sizes it could resemble a mail envelope or ballot box with yes/no marks.
